title: Marketing & Client Services Coordinator
description:
Job Title: Marketing & Client Services Coordinator

Location: Harborne, Birmingham

Basic Salary: £26,000 + Bonuses

Hours: Monday to Friday, 9am - 5:30pm

We're working with a growing independent estate agency looking for a Marketing & Client Services Coordinator to join their team.

This is a varied and exciting role combining property marketing, social media, content creation and client service.

The Role

You'll be involved in a wide range of activities, including:
- Preparing new properties for market, including property descriptions and floorplans
- Planning and creating social media content
- Writing blogs and local property content
- Coordinating direct-mail marketing campaigns
- Creating and repurposing video and property content
- Handling new enquiries and supporting existing clients
- Booking appointments and coordinating communication
- Bringing new ideas to improve the company's marketing and processes
- Managing multiple tasks, projects and deadlines

About You

We're looking for someone who is:
- Organized and highly detail-focused
- Confident communicating with people
- Creative with a good eye for engaging content
- Comfortable using technology and learning new systems
- Able to manage multiple priorities
- Proactive and full of ideas
- Keen to learn, develop and take ownership

Estate agency experience would be beneficial but is not essential. Full training will be provided on the property software, CRM, floorplans and internal processes.

Why Join?

This is a great opportunity to join an ambitious independent estate agency where you'll have the chance to make the role your own.

As the business grows, there will be opportunities to take on more responsibility and develop your career across marketing, client services and property.

The role is initially being recruited due to a maternity leave opening, with the potential for the right person to build a long-term career within the business.

Interested?

If you're organized, creative, confident and looking for a role where no two days are the same, we'd love to hear from you.

title: SEO Manager
description:
Location: Birmingham
Working Pattern: Hybrid - 3 days in the office
Salary: 35,000- 40,000, dependent on experience

The Role

We're looking for an experienced SEO Manager to join a growing digital marketing agency in Birmingham.

This is a great opportunity for an SEO professional who enjoys getting stuck into the detail of SEO strategy, technical SEO, content SEO and organic growth, while also having the opportunity to influence the wider marketing strategy.

You'll work across a small portfolio of client accounts, but a key focus of the role will be growing the agency's own organic visibility. You'll have the opportunity to test SEO ideas, improve website performance and see the impact of your work first-hand.

If you're passionate about SEO, enjoy working with clients and want to develop your experience across both agency and in-house-style SEO, this could be a great next step.

What You'll Be Doing
- Developing and delivering SEO strategies to improve organic visibility, traffic and conversions.
- Taking ownership of the agency's own SEO strategy, identifying opportunities to grow organic search performance.
- Conducting SEO audits, keyword research and performance analysis.
- Managing technical SEO, including site architecture, crawlability, indexing, redirects and other technical improvements.
- Creating and optimising SEO content, including landing pages, service pages, blogs and case studies.
- Improving on-page SEO, metadata, website copy and user experience.
- Using GA4, Google Search Console and SEO tools to identify opportunities and measure performance.
- Working with clients and internal teams to implement SEO recommendations.
- Contributing to client reporting and confidently communicating SEO results, recommendations and next steps.
- Supporting wider marketing activity with a search-first mindset, including content and social media.
- Exploring how AI search, LLM SEO and evolving search behaviour can create new opportunities.
- Sharing SEO insights, trends and best practice with the wider team.

What We're Looking For
- 3+ years of hands-on SEO experience, ideally within a digital marketing or SEO agency.
- Strong knowledge of technical SEO, on-page SEO, content SEO and SEO strategy.
- Experience working with lead generation and/or e-commerce websites.
- Previous client-facing experience, with the ability to build relationships and communicate SEO recommendations clearly.
- Experience using Screaming Frog, Google Analytics, Google Search Console, Google Tag Manager and SEO tools such as Ahrefs, SEMrush or Majestic.
- A commercially minded approach to SEO, with a focus on traffic, leads, conversions and business growth.
- Excellent organisation and time management skills, with the ability to manage multiple SEO projects.
- A genuine interest in how SEO is evolving, including AI search and LLMs.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills.

What's On Offer
- 35,000- 40,000 salary, depending on experience.
- Hybrid working - 3 days per week in a Birmingham office.
- 25 days' holiday, increasing annually.
- Birthdays off.
- Private healthcare.
- Annual wellness fund.
- Company bonus.
- MacBook Pro and an annual budget for hardware, software or accessories.
- Regular company socials.
- Excellent career progression and development opportunities.

title: Digital Marketing Officer
description:
Join us in using good food to create fuller plates, stronger communities and transformed lives across the Midlands
Job Title: Digital Marketing Officer
Reporting to: Senior Marketing & Communications Manager
Location: Flexible within the Midlands, with regular travel around the region required. Birmingham, Leicester or Nottingham base with hybrid/home working available.
Hours: 37.5 hours per week
Benefits: 25 days holiday, pro-rata, 5.5% Employer Pension Contribution including Life Cover, Occupational Sick Pay Benefits & Enhanced Maternity, Adoption and Paternity Leave and Pay, plus more
Contract: Permanent
Salary: £27,845 per annum
About FareShare Midlands
FareShare Midlands rescues good-quality surplus food and gets it to people experiencing hardship through hundreds of community organisations across the region. Last year, we redistributed more than 5,000 tonnes of food - the equivalent of 11 million meals - reaching around 60,000 people every week.
But our impact goes beyond food. We strengthen communities, create opportunities through our SkillsShare employability programmes, and help protect our planet by reducing food waste. Over the next three years, we aim to double the food we rescue and extend our impact across the Midlands.
Good food can do extraordinary things.
The Role
We are looking for a creative, enthusiastic and hands-on Digital Marketing Officer to join our Marketing & Communications team during an exciting period of growth and development for FareShare Midlands.
Working closely with the Senior Marketing & Communications Manager and colleagues across our MarComms, Fundraising and Corporate Partnerships teams, you will help us reach new audiences, tell compelling stories about our impact and inspire people and organisations to support our work.
This is a varied role with plenty of opportunity to develop your digital marketing skills. You will work across our website, social media, Google Ads, email marketing and digital campaigns, as well as helping us capture and share powerful video-led stories from across FareShare Midlands.
A particular focus will be supporting activity that helps generate the partnerships and resources needed to sustain and grow our impact. This includes individual fundraising, corporate partnerships, events and other campaigns designed to engage supporters and inspire action.
We don't expect you to be an expert in everything from day one. We're looking for someone with good digital marketing foundations, strong content and communication skills and the enthusiasm to develop further. You might already be particularly strong in social media, video, websites or digital campaigns and be looking for an opportunity to broaden your experience across the digital marketing mix.
You'll receive support from an experienced MarComms team, while having the opportunity to take ownership of your own activity and develop specialist skills in areas such as WordPress, Google Ads, digital fundraising and performance marketing.
This could be a great next step for someone who has gained practical digital marketing experience and is ready for a role where their work can make a visible difference.
Key Responsibilities
Digital Campaigns, Fundraising & Partnerships
- Work with MarComms, Fundraising and Corporate Partnerships colleagues to plan and deliver engaging digital marketing activity.
- Support fundraising campaigns and appeals, helping to attract new supporters and engage existing donors.
- Develop digital content and campaigns to support corporate partnerships, lead generation and engagement with businesses.
- Support the promotion of fundraising, corporate and other relevant events.
- Help tailor messaging, content and calls to action for different audiences, including donors, businesses, partners and supporters.
- Support integrated campaigns across website, social media, email, digital advertising and other communications channels.
- Work with external agencies and partners on campaigns where appropriate.
- Use campaign results and audience insight to understand what works and help improve future activity.

Website & WordPress
- Support the day-to-day management and development of the FareShare Midlands website.
- Create, edit and update website content, campaign pages and landing pages.
- Help ensure website content is engaging, accessible, up to date and easy for different audiences to navigate.
- Work with our external web/digital partners on technical developments and improvements where required.
- Apply good practice in areas such as SEO, accessibility, user experience and conversion.
- Use website analytics and audience behaviour to help identify opportunities for improvement.

Google Ads & Paid Digital
- Support the day-to-day management of FareShare Midlands' Google Ads activity.
- Help create, monitor and optimise campaigns supporting fundraising, corporate engagement and wider organisational priorities.
- Monitor performance and use data to help improve targeting, messaging and results.
- Support paid social advertising activity alongside organic social campaigns.
- Work with colleagues and external partners where appropriate on digital acquisition and lead-generation campaigns.
- Develop your knowledge and expertise in paid search and digital advertising, keeping up to date with new opportunities and good practice.

Social Media
- Play a key role in planning, creating and managing FareShare Midlands' social media activity.
- Create engaging content tailored to different platforms and audiences.
- Help plan and schedule social media content around organisational priorities, campaigns and events.
- Identify opportunities for timely, engaging and reactive content.
- Support community engagement and help ensure appropriate and timely responses across our channels.
- Contribute to both organic and paid social media campaigns.
- Monitor performance and use insight to understand which content is working and how we can improve.
- Keep abreast of platform developments, trends and emerging formats.

Video, Content & Impact Storytelling
- Help identify and develop compelling stories that demonstrate the impact of FareShare Midlands' work.
- Plan, coordinate, film and edit video content for social media, fundraising campaigns, corporate communications, the website and other digital channels.
- Help organise filming opportunities, working with colleagues, community organisations, volunteers, supporters and other participants.
- Create engaging short-form video content, as well as longer-form content where appropriate.
- Work sensitively and confidently with people sharing their experiences and help ensure appropriate permissions and consent are in place.
- Develop written impact stories, case studies, blogs and other digital content alongside video.
- Ensure content is engaging, accessible, accurate and consistent with the FareShare Midlands brand.
- Work alongside colleagues with specialist design skills to develop high-quality creative content and campaign materials.

Email Marketing & Supporter Journeys
- Support email marketing activity for fundraising, corporate engagement and wider organisational campaigns.
- Create and send engaging, targeted email communications.
- Help grow and engage our email audiences.
- Support the development of email sequences and automated journeys for acquisition, welcome, engagement, stewardship and retention.
- Contribute to FareShare Midlands newsletters and other audience communications.
- Monitor performance including open rates, click-throughs and conversions, using the results to help improve future activity.
- Work with relevant colleagues to ensure supporter and marketing data is accurate, appropriately managed and used effectively.

Reporting & Continuous Improvement
- Help monitor and evaluate digital marketing activity using tools including Google Analytics, Google Ads, social media insights, email marketing data, UTM tracking and campaign dashboards.
- Contribute to setting appropriate measures and KPIs for campaigns.
- Produce straightforward reports and insights that help the team understand performance.
- Use data, audience insight and testing to identify opportunities to improve engagement and conversion.
- Stay curious about developments in digital marketing, search, social media, AI and emerging technology and share relevant ideas and opportunities with the team.

Brand, Compliance & Collaboration
- Act as a brand champion, helping to ensure consistency, accessibility and quality across digital communications.
- Work collaboratively with colleagues across Marketing & Communications, Fundraising, Corporate Partnerships and the wider organisation.
- Build positive relationships with colleagues and help delivery teams communicate their work effectively.
- Ensure digital marketing and fundraising activity complies with GDPR, consent requirements and relevant good practice.
- Support wider marketing and communications campaigns and activity as required.

What We're Looking For
